records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Studio
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Zara replied engaged and said setup is "on our list this week" [email:835f3298]; kickoff held [calendar:c4570643]. But 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and self-described slowness; 8 days left. Intent plus a held kickoff makes it plausible but not likely without a nudge.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Cedar Studio's setup
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for the update — good to know getting everyone set up is on the list this week, and it was great to connect at the kickoff.

When you're ready, the usual first step is one project with a few tasks in it, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. On the team side, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that first project with you — just say the word.

Best,
Nadia
